_competition: While active and before `closes`, the save form asks for an email and the page shows the prize. To end it: set active to false, deploy, then delete the entries (docs/quokka-run.md has the command). The game and every score stay.

competition.prize: a free ticket to AI Disrupt Summit 2026
terms: The top score saved with an email by 11:59pm on 30 November 2026 (Perth time) wins a free ticket to AI Disrupt Summit 2026.
One prize. If two scores tie, whoever got there first wins.
We check the top scores before announcing a winner, and can rule out any that don’t look like they were played fairly.
Your email is only used to contact you if you win. We delete every entrant’s email once the competition is done.
We’ll email the winner in early December.
